versions.content: If SecOCTxSecuredPduCollection is used, the SecOC shall forward the TxConfirmation to the upper layer if the SecOC_TxConfirmation was called for the Authentic I - PDU and the Cryptographic I - PDU. The reult parameter of the upper layer TxConfirmation call shall only be E_OK if the result parameters for both TxConfirmation calls were E_OK , Otherwise the result parameter shall be E_NOT_OK .
